[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Maximum product subarray** [LC 152 · Maximum Product Subarray](https://leetcode.com/problems/maximum-product-subarray/){difficulty="Medium"}

Copying Kadane's algorithm (@sec-cx-p1-max-subarray) and replacing $+$ by $\times$ is wrong: a very **negative** product ending at $i$ becomes the best product after one more negative number. Keep both the largest and the smallest product ending at $i$.

[Solved in full in @sec-test-p1-product.]{.card-link}

:::
